text:
elaine: Quick kickoff for May webinar + launch posts. Goal: push more product-led activations by tying in gated quick-start prompt packs and small credit incentives. Want an ABN test across messaging + credit size.

rob: Proposed experiment arms:
- Control: standard webinar + generic follow-up (no credits)
- T1: persona-specific prompt packs (3 personas) sent post-attendance
- T2: prompt packs + 25 free credits (attendee-only)
- T3: prompt packs + 100 free credits + 2-day timed nudge in-app/email
Hypothesis: T3 lifts 7-day activation but may cost more; T2 might be most cost-effective. :money_with_wings:

mike: Important metrics to capture: webinar_attended, followup_email_sent, prompt_pack_clicked, credit_redeemed, first_api_call, paid_conversion_30d. Also metric: tokens_consumed_first_week to estimate unit cost.

zoe: Copy ideas for launch posts (Twitter/LinkedIn) and the landing page hero. Quick options:
- "Hands-on inference: join our live workshop + get a starter prompt pack"
- "Ship LLM features with less cost — learn batching & caching"
CTA variants we should test: "Reserve seat", "Get starter pack", "Save my credits".

elaine: For routing, we need persona selection on the form: "Product", "Data", "Platform". Routing rules: Product -> product-nurture, Data -> data-nurture, Platform -> infra-nurture. Zoe, can you confirm copy for the persona dropdown and microcopy explaining credits?

zoe: Will do. Also propose a pre-event micro-benchmark teaser post highlighting "typical query cost before vs after tuning" with concrete numbers. Example blurb: "From $0.12/query -> $0.03/query using prefix caching + 8-bit quantization" (numbers illustrative).

rob: Ops: if dedicated capacity is saturated, fall back to hosted variant. Add preferred_model and fallback_model fields to the registration payload. Also track model_used in credit_redemption event.

ops-bot: Reminder: calendar created for May 14 webinar. Auto-reminders set at 48h, 2h, and 15m.

mike: Landing instrumentation snippet (send to inbound webhook).

mike: ```json
{"event":"webinar_registered","email":"{{email}}","persona":"{{persona}}","preferred_model":"redwood-rtx-1","fallback_model":"redwood-hosted-1","utm":"may-webinar"}
```

elaine: Email cadence (post-attendance): immediate pack + credits email, day 1 nudge, day 3 use-case spotlight, day 7 success story + CTA to book a demo. For T3 add an extra in-app nudge at 48h.

zoe: Subject line variants to A/B test for the post-attendance email:
A) "Your starter prompts + credits inside"
B) "Build an LLM feature in 10 minutes (starter pack)"
C) "We put credits in your account — try these prompts"

rob: Tracking plan: each cohort should have a cohort_id; include cohort_id on every event. We'll also expose a dashboard with: registered->attended rate, attended->credit_redeem rate, credit_redeem->first_api_call, and cost per activated user (credits$ + infra estimate).

mike: Quick benchmark narrative draft for slides:
1) Problem: onboarding friction + cold prompts -> low usage
2) Experiment: give curated persona packs + small credits + nudges
3) Expected lead gen: higher short-term usage, test whether nudges convert to paid
4) Slide: sample table (avg tokens/session, sessions/week, est cost/user) before vs after.

elaine: Can we also test a tiny UX tweak: show a "Use your credits" button in the account header for 7 days after event vs no button. That might amplify T2/T3. Add as a 2x2 within T2/T3? Keep sample sizes in mind.

zoe: Good point. We'll limit 2x2 to a subset (20% of T2/T3) to avoid budget blowout.

rob: Ops note: set a hard cap on free credit redemptions per campaign (e.g., $12k total) and stop granting when cap hit. Also add an alert to #finance if redemptions reach 80% of cap.

mike: Quick snippet for the follow-up email CTA url with utm/cohort:

mike: ```text
https://redwood.ai/start?utm_campaign=may-webinar&utm_source=email&cohort_id={{cohort_id}}
```

elaine: Deliverables & owners:
- Tracking document + dashboard (rob)
- Prompt pack creation (mike)
- Copy for landing + emails + social (zoe)
- Ops: webhook + cap enforcement (nora)
Deadline: EOD Tue. Quick check-in tomorrow 10am?

rob: I'll sketch the dashboard and start setting cohort ids.

zoe: I'll post draft social copy in #marketing-drafts later today.

mike: Working on three persona packs (minimal, recommended, full examples). Will include quick-run code snippets for JS and Python.

ops-bot: Task created: marketing/may-webinar-campaign assigned to elaine, rob, mike, zoe. Due: 3 days.

elaine: Great. Meeting 10am tomorrow. Thanks all :raised_hands:
